description.text: One of the two XY11 expansions released together on 17 June 2016, a month before the film in which Volcanion, Magearna and a black Mega Gardevoir appear. Its headline is a shiny, black M Gardevoir-EX of Fairy and Psychic type, one of the XY11 dual-type Pokémon, whose cards have two types and frames split between two colors. Magearna-EX made its card debut here, with Yveltal BREAK, Hydreigon BREAK and Yanmega BREAK. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 54, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Pokémon Ranger and an Ultra Rare gold Gardevoir-EX. In English most of its cards came out in Steam Siege in August 2016.
